title: HearHere: Mitigating Echo Chambers in News Consumption through an AI-based Web System

bias_targets.methodology: Predicting the political stance (e.g., liberal, conservative, center) and extremeness of news articles and online comments using a graph-based AI model (knowledge-aware hierarchical attention networks), and evaluating the mitigation of users' political confirmation bias (echo chambers) using pre- and post-survey 'Echo chamber breaking scores'.
